author: Warren Buffett
quote: Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing. Warren Buffett

author: Warren Buffett
quote: Never risk what you have and need for the sake of what you don't have.

author: Warren Buffett
quote: Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.

author: Warren Buffett
quote: The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.

author: Warren Buffett
quote: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.

author: Warren Buffett
quote: Our greatest weakness is when we give up. And our greatest strength is persistence.

author: Peter Lynch
quote: Know what you own, and know why you own it.

author: Peter Lynch
quote: The key to making money in stocks is not to get scared out of them.

author: Peter Lynch
quote: Go for a bargain that's sitting there doing nothing.

author: Jesse Livermore
quote: The big money is not in individual stocks, it is in the market trends.

author: Jesse Livermore
quote: There is nothing new in Wall Street. There can't be anything new, in the street itself; because speculation is a repeating game.

author: Jesse Livermore
quote: A man is a fool if he says he can't get even.

author: Jesse Livermore
quote: The desire for oil, or any commodity, is in the man, not in the market.

author: Paul Tudor Jones
quote: The most important rule is to never, ever lose money.

author: Paul Tudor Jones
quote: Risk-adjusted returns are the name of the game.

author: Paul Tudor Jones
quote: I've learned to be a better listener and a worse talker.

author: Howard Marks
quote: You can't predict, but you can prepare.

author: Howard Marks
quote: The greatest thing a person can do is to make the best decisions possible with the information available.

author: Howard Marks
quote: When you're optimistic, you're in a minority. And when you're pessimistic, you're also in a minority. But in markets, the minority is usually right.

author: Stan Druckenmiller
quote: The key to being a good trader is to have an edge, and the key to having an edge is to have a process that no one else has.

author: Stan Druckenmiller
quote: My sin was in falling in love with my ideas and not cutting my losses.

author: Mark Douglas
quote: The secret to trading is the ability to make the correct decision. The ability to make money is secondary.

author: Mark Douglas
quote: Your beliefs determine what you see, and then what you see confirms your beliefs.

author: Mark Douglas
quote: If you can accept the reality that there is always uncertainty in the market, and yet still be comfortable with that, then you'll be able to take the next step.

author: John Templeton
quote: The investor who says, 'This is the worst bear market ever,' is usually right. The investor who says 'This is the best buying opportunity since 1970,' should be careful.

author: John Templeton
quote: If you buy the same stock twice, you have not made a mistake — you have made a mistake if you sell it too soon.

author: George Soros
quote: The successful gambler makes a habit of risking a small amount in a large-potential-payoff situation.

author: George Soros
quote: Reflexivity is the key to understanding how markets work.

author: George Soros
quote: It's not whether you're right or wrong that's important, but how much you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.

author: Ray Dalio
quote: The biggest mistake investors make is probably feeling too much confidence in their views and not having the humility to recognize that markets are complicated.

author: Ray Dalio
quote: You get a punch card with only 20 trades in your lifetime. Don't waste them.

author: Ray Dalio
quote: The ability to deal with loss is what separates successful investors from unsuccessful ones.

author: Carl Icahn
quote: I think the most important thing is to be a contrarian, to look for opportunities where others are not looking.

author: Carl Icahn
quote: If you're not 100% confident in your own research, don't put money in it.

author: Benjamin Graham
quote: The investor's chief problem — even his worst enemy — is likely to be himself.

author: Benjamin Graham
quote: In the short run, the market is a voting machine, but in the long run, it's a weighing machine.

author: Benjamin Graham
quote: Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.

author: John Bogle
quote: Time is your friend, impulse is your enemy. No impulse buying in business or investment.

author: John Bogle
quote: Don't look for the needle — just buy the haystack.

author: John Bogle
quote: The little things — costs, taxes, the time you spend — really do matter.

author: Paul Samuelson
quote: Investing should be more like watching paint dry or watching insects on a countertop with a dull rusty magnifying glass.

author: Paul Samuelson
quote: The stock market grants rewards to the few who exercise wisdom, and inflicts heavy losses on the many who act in folly.

author: Richard Dripp
quote: Never test the depth of the water with both feet.

author: Richard Dripp
quote: The goal is not to be perfect, but to be consistent.

author: Mohnish Pabrai
quote: If you buy a wonderful business at a fair price, you'll do well. But if you buy a fair business at a wonderful price, you'll also do well.

author: Mohnish Pabrai
quote: The power of compounding is the most powerful force in the world.

author: Charlie Munger
quote: The first rule is don't fool yourself — and you're the easiest person to fool.

author: Charlie Munger
quote: It's far better to buy a wonderful business at a fair price than a fair business at a wonderful price.

author: Charlie Munger
quote: All goodinvesting is obviously and necessarily based on the intersection of the concepts of simplicity and multidisciplinary.

author: Vitaliy Kats
quote: Markets are complex, but investing doesn't have to be complicated.

author: Vitaliy Kats
quote: The biggest risk is not taking any risk.
